name: When should I get a storm-related roof condition report?

mainEntity.name: When should I get a storm-related roof condition report?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should get a storm-related roof condition report as soon as possible after a significant weather event, such as a hailstorm or high winds, even if damage isn't immediately obvious. Many types of storm damage, like small hail dents or lifted shingles, may not cause leaks immediately but can lead to larger issues over time. Prompt assessment allows for timely insurance claims and prevents minor damage from escalating. Consider scheduling an inspection if you notice fallen tree limbs, damaged siding, or see other roof damage in your neighborhood, as these are strong indicators that your property may have been affected.
acceptedAnswer.description: Get a report after a significant storm, even if damage isn't obvious, to document issues for insurance and prevent future problems.
